categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Hollywave Electronic System Co., Ltd. focuses on three main business segments: electromagnetic measurement systems, electromagnetic field simulation and verification software (CAE software), and phased array products. These segments serve high-end manufacturing industries including special equipment, aerospace, satellite, communication, and automotive sectors. The company also engages in general testing business and software and information system integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core proprietary technologies such as 3D full-wave electromagnetic simulation, low-cost sparse array technology, radar cross-section (RCS) measurement, planar near-field multi-probe measurement, multi-probe mid-field calibration, multi-channel active parameter measurement, on-orbit calibration, microsecond-level real-time control, and phased array rapid design and optimization. Production involves software development, hardware design and assembly, system integration, and testing, with a focus on algorithm and software development and self-produced core hardware components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national defense and aerospace institutions, scientific research institutes, and major communication equipment manufacturers such as China Electronics Technology Group, Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Electronics Corporation, China Aviation Engine Group, Chinese Academy of Sciences, ZTE Corporation, and Datang Mobile. The primary markets served are special equipment, aerospace, satellite communications, electronic information, and emerging sectors like low-altitude economy and intelligent driving.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated within mainland China, with subsidiaries and business activities also in Hong Kong. The company has established subsidiaries in Shanghai, Beijing, Xi'an, Chengdu, and Hong Kong to cover major domestic regions and support national strategic industries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Hollywave operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and production of electromagnetic simulation software, measurement systems, and phased array products. It provides critical testing, calibration, and simulation tools that support product development and manufacturing in high-tech industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in electromagnetic simulation and measurement technologies, aiming to enhance the precision, efficiency, and integration of its products. Strategic R&D directions include advancing CAE software capabilities with cloud computing and AI integration, improving measurement system automation and accuracy, and developing low-cost, highly integrated phased array technologies. The company also emphasizes expanding applications in aerospace, satellite, communication, automotive, and emerging industries such as low-altitude economy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electromagnetic measurement systems, CAE simulation software licenses, phased array products, and related services. The company employs a direct sales model supported by bidding and business negotiations, with contracts signed upon order confirmation and project delivery. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Hollywave is positioned as a leading domestic player with advanced proprietary technologies in electromagnetic simulation and measurement, holding a competitive edge in the Chinese market. It is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. The company competes with international CAE software providers who dominate approximately 90% of the market but is accelerating domestic technological catch-up. It holds leading positions in phased array calibration and radar cross-section measurement systems within China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 269 million, a 31.75% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.43 million, down 46.76%. Despite revenue decline due to project delivery timing, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 963 million and net assets of RMB 650 million. R&D investment accounted for 15.68% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company has experienced fluctuations in cash flow due to project scale and customer payment cycles but continues to invest in growth and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Hollywave emphasizes its unique value through proprietary algorithmic technologies that integrate electromagnetic simulation and calibration measurement, enabling mutual verification and rapid iteration. Its products offer high precision, efficiency, and automation tailored for complex, high-reliability applications in strategic industries. The company’s comprehensive solutions cover the full product lifecycle from design simulation to production calibration, supported by strong engineering experience and participation in major national aerospace and satellite projects, distinguishing it from competitors.
